newsitem.title: GERMANY: Military planners end Zaire meeting in Germany.
newsitem.headline: Military planners end Zaire meeting in Germany.

text.p: Western and African military officials on Sunday ended a meeting to discuss possible military options for an international relief mission to help refugees in Zaire and Rwanda.
"The meeting has been completed," a Canadian forces' spokesman told Reuters. He said a news conference would be held later at Kelley Barracks at the U.S. European Command in Stuttgart.
He did not give any indication about the outcome of the meeting.
The planners were not expected to make a decision about whether to send a military force to Africa but to outline the various options for consideration by national governments.
The meeting began on Friday but dragged on through the weekend as military officials and aid group representatives struggled to agree on how many refugees needed help.
Support for a planned task force in eastern Zaire has cooled with the return of hundreds of thousands of refugees to Rwanda and a decision by the United States not to commit combat troops.
